name: Somalia
dated: Income Tax Law (Sharciga Canshuurta Dakhliga), Law No. 37 of 11 May 2025, in force on the President's signature (art. 106); the previous law applies only to tax years ending before that date (art. 105 (3) (b)), so the 2025 tax year falls under Law 37

cit.name: Income tax on corporations
cit.statute: Law No. 37 of 2025 (Income Tax Law) First Schedule art. 3 (rate of income tax for corporations: 15 % flat); art. 4 (1): Somali permanent establishments at the same rate
cit.doc: Law 37/2025 First Schedule, Qodobka 3-aad "Boqolleeyda Canshuurta Dakhliga ee Lagu Dabaqaayo Shirkadaha (Rate of Income Tax for Corporations): Dakhliga canshuur-galka ah ee Shirkaddaha ee sanad canshuureedka waxa lagu canshuuraayaa boqolkiiba shan iyo toban (15%) oo ah boqolleey siman." (the taxable income of corporations for the tax year is taxed at fifteen percent, a flat rate). Art. 106: the Law enters into force when approved by Parliament and signed by the President (signed 11 May 2025); art. 105 (3) (b): the former law continues to apply to tax obligations for tax years ending before that date.
notes: Law 37 took effect on 11 May 2025; the former law governs only tax years ending before then, so the 15 % rate applies to the whole 2025 tax year
the OCR prints 'boqolkiiba' as 'bogolkiiba' and 'oo' as '00'

wht.name: Withholding tax on Somali-source payments (Law 37/2025 art. 91-92)
wht.statute: Law No. 37 of 2025 art. 91 (investment returns) and 92 (1) (t) (service fees paid to non-residents), rates in First Schedule art. 5 (1) (t) and (j): dividends 5 %, interest 10 %, royalties 15 %, service fees 10 %
wht.doc: First Schedule Qodobka 5-aad (Rates of Withholding Tax) (1) "t) lacag-bixinnada lagu dabaqaayo Qodobka 91-aad (investment returns): i. haddii ay tahay faa'idada saamiga (dividend), waxaa lagu canshuurayaa boqolkiiba shan (5%); ii. haddii ay tahay faa'idada ka dhalata qaamaha (returns on debt claims), waxaa lagu canshuurayaa boqolkiiba toban (10%); ... v. hadii ay tahay khidmadda kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ama khidmadda xuquuqda milkiyadda (royalty), waxaa lagu canshuurayaa boqolkiiba shan iyo toban (15%); j) lacag-bixinnada lagu dabaqaayo Qodobka 92-aad (service fees): ... ii. haddii ay tahay khidmadaha adeegga ee lagu sheegay Qodobka 92(1) (t), waxaa lagu canshuurayaa boqolkiiba toban (10%)". Art. 91 (1): a resident (including a Somali permanent establishment) paying a dividend, natural-resource fee, rent, return on a debt claim or royalty sourced in Somalia withholds at the art. 5 rate; art. 92 (1) (t): a service fee or insurance premium sourced in Somalia paid to a non-resident.

rules.statute: First Schedule art. 5 (1) (t) (ii): returns on debt claims 10 %
First Schedule art. 5 (1) (t) (v): royalties and natural-resource fees 15 %
First Schedule art. 5 (1) (j) (ii): service fees under art. 92 (1) (t) (paid to a non-resident) 10 %

notes: whether the withholding is the non-resident's final tax was not established from the OCR (art. 94 not read); it is applied as the statutory withholding on the payment
insurance premiums paid to non-residents (5 %) and rents (5 % / 10 %) are not modelled lines
unsupported: finality of the withholding for non-residents (art. 94 not read)
